question: How is vijnanakala-ness created on Maya-holders by Ananta's impulsion?
premises: but on Maya-holders, may be created by Ananta-lord, from impulsion
inference: Ananta-impelled Maya-holders gain vijnanakala-ness by mere authority.
uncertainties: anantesa reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: But on Maya-holders, may be created by Ananta-lord, from impulsion — vijnanakala-ness attained, from mere authority.
